targetSelection.selectionReason: Security dimension over every changed hunk plus the helpers the changed check depends on; the question is whether narrowing 13a removes a security control and whether the new code adds injection, path, secret, DoS or isolation surface.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Removing the ROUTER.md follower could remove a guard that gates a security decision.

searchActions.result: The function only reads version fields, compares strings and emits pass/softFail verdicts; nothing consumes the result for authorization, mutation or enforcement.

searchLedger.rationale: 13a is a diagnostic parity check over release metadata, not an auth or mutation control, so no security guard is removed.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: diagnostic metadata comparison; no guard role, no enforcement path

searchLedger.hypothesis: Hub-controlled version values or file names could inject terminal escapes or content into doctor output.

searchActions.result: authority is validated by FOUR_PART_VERSION before interpolation; the follower value passes through JSON.stringify in the malformed branch; file names are hardcoded literals; no shell or HTML sink.

searchLedger.rationale: All interpolated values are validated or escaped; no new interpolation was added.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: validated authority plus JSON.stringify-escaped values; hardcoded file labels

searchLedger.hypothesis: FOUR_PART_VERSION could backtrack catastrophically on a crafted version string.

searchActions.result: Anchored pattern [0-9]+ with one bounded repetition group; no nested unbounded quantifiers.

searchLedger.rationale: Linear pattern; the change applies it to one fewer input.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: linear anchored regex, no catastrophic backtracking

searchLedger.hypothesis: Checker or test file access could traverse outside the audited hub.

searchActions.result: markdownVersion joins ctx.target with a fixed caller-supplied name; the change removes one such read (ROUTER.md); the new test writes inside its own buildHub() temp copy.

searchLedger.rationale: No new path construction; the diff reduces the read surface by one file.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: fixed relative names under the target root; one read removed, none added

searchLedger.hypothesis: Changed lines could expose credentials or sensitive data.

searchActions.queryOrPath: review-diff.patch hunks for both YAML twins and frontmatter-versioning.md
searchActions.result: Changed lines contain a version-carrier list and a doc paragraph; no credential, token, PII or environment value.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no secret or PII content in changed lines

searchLedger.invariant: No dependency, manifest or install-script change is present in the diff.

searchActions.result: Five files: two YAML assets, one doctor script, one test and one doc; no package manifest, lockfile or install script.

searchLedger.rationale: No dependency resolution surface is touched.
searchLedger.notApplicableReason: no dependency, manifest, lockfile or install-script change

searchLedger.invariant: The narrowed comparison was never an integrity or tamper-detection control; a hub ROUTER.md keeps its own edition by operator ruling.

searchActions.result: The standard now states no gate compares ROUTER.md with SKILL.md; the doctor check is advisory diagnostic output whose FAIL affects only the hub verdict, and no runtime consumer uses ROUTER.md version equality for trust decisions.

searchLedger.rationale: No security control is downgraded; version parity is release hygiene, not integrity enforcement.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: advisory diagnostic, no enforcement consumer; own-edition semantics are the declared contract

searchLedger.hypothesis: The new test could mutate shared state or leave artifacts that affect later runs.

searchActions.result: Each test builds a fresh hub via buildHub() in its own temp root; the new case mutates only that copy; after() removes every temp root.

searchLedger.rationale: Per-test temp hubs with suite-end cleanup; no shared or persistent state touched.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: private temp copy per test with after() cleanup
